items.source:
The cache operation is static and independent of a particular invocation;
this interface gathers the operation and a particular invocation.
items.translation: 缓存操作是静态的，且独立于特定的调用；此接口将操作与特定的调用聚合在一起。

items.source: Return the argument list used to invoke the method.
items.translation: 返回用于调用该方法的参数列表。

items.source: Return the method which was invoked.
Return the target instance on which the method was invoked.
items.translation: 返回调用该方法的实例。
